blocks.title: <ico-recycle></ico-recycle> REPASO EXPRESS · lección anterior
blocks.intro: Antes de empezar, recupera lo de la clase pasada. Une cada expresión con su significado, sin mirar atrás.

blocks.title: <ico-book></ico-book> HE SAID, SHE ASKED
blocks.intro: Para contar lo que dijo otra persona, el verbo da un paso atrás en el tiempo y cambian los pronombres. Con seis verbos más precisos que say, tu resumen dice también con qué intención se dijo.

vocab.sp: volver a contactar a alguien con una respuesta

blocks.note: Cómo funciona: tarjetas , escucha , completar , comparar , reescribir y memory. CHECK donde lo veas.

parts.html: 1 · UN PASO ATRÁS — is → was · will → would · did → had done

items.en: He said they would renew the contract.
items.sp: «We will renew the contract.» — will → would, we → they.

items.en: He said he had seen the report.
items.sp: «I saw the report.» — saw → had seen.

parts.html: 2 · SAY ALGO, TELL A ALGUIEN — tell siempre lleva persona

items.en: He said that the price was too high.
He told me that the price was too high.
items.sp: tell + a quién + lo que dijo.

parts.html: 3 · PREGUNTAS: ORDEN DE AFIRMACIÓN — sin do, sin inversión, sin signo de pregunta

items.en: He asked when we could start.
items.sp: «When can you start?» — sujeto antes del verbo.

items.en: He asked whether we could add an app.
items.sp: «Can you add an app?» — pregunta de sí o no: whether / if.

items.en: She asked where the report was.
items.sp: «Where is the report?» — was va al final.

parts.html: 4 · TAMBIÉN CAMBIAN EL TIEMPO Y EL LUGAR

items.en: He said he would call the next day.
She said she had landed the day before.

parts.html: 5 · VERBOS MÁS PRECISOS QUE «SAY» — cada uno con su estructura

items.en: He promised to send the report.
He agreed to wait until Friday.
She refused to give a discount.
He warned us that he might leave.

parts.html: TRAMPA DEL ESPAÑOL — «me dijo», «me preguntó dónde estaba», «me sugirió que»

items.sp: «Me dijo» = he told me. Nunca he said me.

items.en: He asked me where the report was.
items.sp: En español el verbo va antes («dónde estaba el informe»); en inglés, al final.

items.en: She suggested that I call David.
items.sp: «Me sugirió que llamara» = suggested that I call / suggested calling. Nunca suggested me to.

parts.body: He said me that… → He told me that… · He asked me where was the report. → He asked me where the report was. · She suggested me to call. → She suggested calling.

blocks.title: REPORTING VERBS · toca para girar
blocks.intro: Diez verbos para resumir una conversación con precisión. Aprende cada uno con su estructura.

cards.back: recordarle a alguien que haga algo

blocks.title: <ico-star></ico-star> WHO SAID WHAT?
blocks.intro: David llama mientras Priya está en un vuelo. Marcos atiende, toma notas y esa noche tiene que contarle todo. Cada palabra importa: David está decidiendo si renueva el contrato.

cast.sp: en un vuelo hasta la noche

blocks.title: AUDIO 1 · THE CALL
blocks.desc: David llama y Priya no está. Escucha con atención qué pide exactamente: lo vas a necesitar para el segundo audio.

questions.q: Why can't David speak to Priya?
On what condition will David renew the contract?
options: If the mobile app is free
If the report arrives on Friday

questions.q: What does David want by Friday?
Why does David mention another agency?
options: He has already decided to leave
To put pressure on Priya's team

speaking.prompt: Report three things David said, each with a different verb: said, asked, warned.
speaking.starter: David said (that) he… He asked whether we… He warned us that he…

transcript.html: Marcos? It's David. I need to speak to Priya.
Hi, David. I'm afraid Priya's on a flight until this evening. Can I take a message?
You'd better write this down. First, I'm still not happy about the pricing incident. The report was good, but my board is nervous.
I understand. I'll tell her.
Second, the contract. It ends next month. I will renew it, but only if I get a discount. Twenty percent.
Twenty percent. I can't agree to that myself, but I'll pass it on.
I know you can't. I need an answer by Friday. Not next week. Friday.
An answer by Friday. Got it.
And one more thing. My customers keep asking for a mobile app. Can your team add one?
A mobile app. I think so, but let me check with Priya.
Do that. And Marcos, I'm talking to another agency tomorrow. I'm not saying I'll leave. I'm saying I have options.
Understood. Priya will call you as soon as she lands.
Good. Goodbye, Marcos.

blocks.title: ONE STEP BACK
blocks.intro: Pasa cada frase a estilo indirecto: el verbo retrocede un tiempo, y cambian pronombres y palabras de tiempo.

items.q: «We will renew.» → He said they ___ renew.
«I saw the report.» → He said he ___ the report.
«Can you add an app?» → He asked whether we ___ add an app.
«I'll call tomorrow.» → He said he would call ___.
He ___ me that the price was too high.
«I have options.» → He said he ___ options.

blocks.title: HE SAID vs HE TOLD ME
blocks.intro: Los dos significan «dijo», pero no se construyen igual. Uno necesita siempre a quién se lo dijo.

pair.a: He said that the board was nervous.
pair.b: He told me that the board was nervous.

items.q: ¿Cuál necesita siempre una persona después del verbo?

options: He told to me the truth.

items.q: No quieres decir a quién se lo dijo. ¿Cuál es correcta?
options: He said that he was busy.
He told that he was busy.
He said me that he was busy.

items.q: Ella dio una instrucción. ¿Cuál es correcta?
Priya quiere los detalles de la llamada. ¿Qué pregunta?

blocks.title: AUDIO 2 · THE REPORT
blocks.desc: Esa noche, Marcos le cuenta la llamada a Priya. Casi todo está bien… pero un detalle no es lo que David dijo. Compara con el primer audio.

questions.q: According to Marcos, how did David feel about the incident?
options: He was satisfied with the report

questions.q: Compare with Audio 1. Which part of Marcos's report is wrong?
options: David wanted the app by Friday
David was talking to another agency

questions.q: What did Marcos tell David about the discount?
options: That he couldn't agree to it himself

questions.q: What could Marcos's mistake cost the team?
options: Priya might say no to something David never asked for
David might get the app for free
Priya might miss her next flight

speaking.prompt: Fix Marcos's report. Tell Priya what David really said about Friday and about the app.
speaking.starter: Actually, David said he needed (what) by Friday. About the app, he only asked whether (what).

transcript.html: Okay, Marcos, I've landed. What exactly did David say?
I took notes. First, he said he was still not happy about the pricing incident. He said the report was good, but his board was nervous.
Fair enough. And the contract?
He said he would renew it, but only if he got a discount. He asked for twenty percent.
Twenty! Did you agree to anything?
No. I told him I couldn't agree to that myself.
Good. What else?
He asked whether we could add a mobile app. And he said he wanted the app by Friday.
The app by Friday? That's impossible. If that's his condition, I'll have to tell him no.
He also warned us that he was talking to another agency the next day.
Then we can't afford any mistakes. Send me your notes, word for word.

blocks.title: DIRECT → REPORTED
blocks.intro: Reescribe lo que se dijo en estilo indirecto. Un paso atrás en el tiempo; en las preguntas, orden de afirmación.

answers: David said he was not happy.
David said that he was not happy.
David said that he was unhappy.

items.source: "I will renew the contract," he said.
answers: He said he would renew the contract.
He said that he would renew the contract.

items.source: "Can you add an app?" he asked us.
answers: He asked us whether we could add an app.
He asked us if we could add an app.
items.why: Pregunta de sí o no: whether / if + sujeto + could.

answers: He asked me where Priya was.
items.why: Orden de afirmación: Priya was, no was Priya.

items.source: "I need an answer by Friday," he said.
answers: He said he needed an answer by Friday.
He said that he needed an answer by Friday.
Marcos promised to send the notes.
Marcos promised that he would send the notes.
Marcos promised he would send the notes.

blocks.title: MEMORY · the quote and the report
blocks.intro: Une cada frase dicha con su resumen. El verbo del resumen te dice la intención.

pairs.b: She refused to give a discount.
He warned us that he might leave.

blocks.title: <ico-pen></ico-pen> THE CALL NOTES
blocks.intro:
Un cliente llamó y dijo estas cinco cosas. Escribe las notas para Priya en estilo indirecto (5 frases):
«The service is too slow.» · «Can you deliver by Monday?» · «If this happens again, I'll cancel.» · «OK, I'll wait one more week.» · «Why don't we talk every Friday?»
checklist: Una afirmación con said that + un paso atrás
Una pregunta con asked whether + orden de afirmación
blocks.example: David said that la queja, un paso atrás. He asked whether sujeto + could…. He warned us that qué pasaría. He agreed to verbo. He suggested verbo-ing.
blocks.hw: Escribe las notas y después grábate contándole la llamada a Priya, sin leer. Envíame texto y audio por WhatsApp.

rubric.d: Reportaste las cinco frases del cliente, cada una con su verbo.
El tiempo retrocede un paso, la pregunta va en orden de afirmación y cada verbo lleva su estructura (to / that / -ing).
Un lector lo entiende sin releer, y nada cambia el sentido de lo que dijo el cliente.
